name: github-runner CI
description: The two pools this repository's own CI needs. The ui job runs in a container: node comes from setup-node and nothing leaves the working tree. The other three need a machine — go because `go test -race` needs a C compiler and the runner image has none, container-runner because it needs a Docker daemon it may destroy containers in, installer because it installs a systemd service as root and then deletes it. Import both, or the fleet can only serve part of the workflow.
